meaning: A crook pretends to be a loving partner online. After gaining your trust, they ask you for money.
clues: It starts with a stranger who says they love you.
The person sends lots of sweet messages and photos, and may say they live far away.
They always have a reason they cannot meet in person or talk on video.
Sooner or later they ask for money, often for an emergency.
It has two words. The first has seven letters and starts with R.
assumes: A tech support scam starts with a fake computer problem
A prize scam says you won a contest

decoys.meaning: Someone says your computer has a problem. Then they ask for money or access to fix it.
You are told you won a contest, but you must pay a fee or share private details to collect.
Someone uses your name or account numbers without your permission, such as to buy things in your name.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, a pen pal never asked me for money. I guess the stamp was enough!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Say no to any request for money from someone you have never met. Talk to a person you trust first.

sources.name: FTC, What To Know About Romance Scams

blank.sentence: He acted like a loving partner online. After I trusted him, he asked me for money. That was a ___.

why: The crook builds trust first, then asks you for money.
short: Fake sweetheart who asks for money
